description: This file defines the Env class within the JmesPath namespace, providing environment-based runtime configuration and search functionalities for JMESPath expressions, including methods for creating runtimes, cleaning compiled files, and retrieving environment variables.

classes.name: Env
classes.description: Provides environment-based configuration and runtime creation methods for JMESPath.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Evaluates a JMESPath expression against provided data, utilizing a cached runtime.

methods.name: createRuntime
methods.description: Creates and returns a JMESPath runtime based on environment variables.

methods.name: cleanCompileDir
methods.description: Deletes previously compiled JMESPath files from the specified compile directory or system temp directory.

methods.name: getEnvVariable
methods.description: Fetches an environment variable from $_SERVER, $_ENV, or the environment via getenv().
